senses.example: La farmacia está al lado del ambulatorio.
senses.exampleGloss: The pharmacy is next to the health centre.

alternatives.reason: Older Peninsular word; charming but rarely used now.
Cleaning products, not medicines; a common confusion.
Non-prescription goods shop; a related but distinct place.

notes: ambulatorio is the Peninsular health centre; keeping it in the example teaches the everyday pairing.
